title: Enterprise Software Business Equity Stake For Sale in Lapu-Lapu, Philippines
tagline: Tech startup based in Lapu-Lapu, Cebu, focused on HR and operations management. - Our technology-driven system combines software with hardware for access control and ID/barcode systems. - The business is currently in the pre-revenue stage and is founder-led. - We plan to generate revenue by selling and implementing the platform and associated hardware for client businesses. - Revenue streams include one-time installation and hardware fees at the time of implementation, along with ongoing monthly subscription fees for cloud and platform services. - The business is registered with DTI. - The owner has exhausted personal funds, resulting in operational funding challenges and the need for equity investment. - We are seeking equity investment to address operational funding requirements and support the business's growth.
